title: Geothermal Electricity Ordinance Extraction Schema
description: Extract regulatory requirements from ordinances governing geothermal electricity generation. STRICT SCOPE: Only extract requirements that apply to GEOTHERMAL ELECTRICITY (geothermal power plants, geothermal production/injection wells for electricity, commercial geothermal energy facilities). EXCLUDE ENTIRELY: geothermal heat pumps (GHP), residential geothermal HVAC, direct-use heating/cooling, solar power (even if in same document), wind power, biomass, and all other non-geothermal energy. If a requirement is in a section titled 'Solar Power' or 'Wind Energy', DO NOT extract it - it does not apply to geothermal.

applies_to_geothermal_electricity.description: True if ordinance contains ANY provisions regulating geothermal ELECTRICITY generation. False if document only covers GHP, solar, wind, or no geothermal content.

extraction_approach.description: REQUIRED: Explicitly state what sections/provisions were EXTRACTED (geothermal only) and what sections were EXCLUDED (solar, wind, GHP, etc.). This accountability prevents mixing technologies. Format: 'Extracted [geothermal sections]; Excluded [non-geothermal sections with specific names like Section 6-4-12G solar power]'
examples: Extracted geothermal provisions from Article N.G Geothermal Development Overlay Zone (Sections 6-3N-1 through 6-3N-12); Excluded solar power requirements from Section 6-4-12G, excluded residential GHP from Section 6-3C-2
Extracted commercial geothermal energy regulations from Division 17; Excluded general zoning unrelated to energy production
Document contains only solar and wind provisions - no geothermal electricity content found; Excluded all sections

relevant_sections.description: List ONLY the ordinance sections that regulate geothermal electricity, exactly as cited (e.g., 'Article N.G Sections 6-3N-1 through 6-3N-12', 'Division 17', 'Chapter 26.138'). Leave null if no geothermal electricity provisions.

state.description: State name exactly as written in document.

county.description: County name exactly as written (keep 'County' suffix if present).

ordinance_code.description: Ordinance number/code/title exactly as written. Leave null if not stated.

requirements.description: Array of requirements that apply to GEOTHERMAL ELECTRICITY ONLY. CRITICAL FILTERING RULE: Before extracting any requirement, verify the ordinance section it comes from is about GEOTHERMAL (not solar/wind/other). Check section headings/titles. If a section is titled 'Solar Power Generation' or similar, SKIP IT ENTIRELY - those requirements do not apply to geothermal even if setback distances might be similar. Each unique requirement = one entry.

subtype.description: Specific subcategory for GEOTHERMAL operations. Be specific - use terms from the ordinance. Examples: 'Geothermal drilling operations', 'Geothermal power plant operations', 'Geothermal production well', 'Geothermal exploration'. NEVER use subtypes like 'Solar power generation' or 'Wind turbine' - those should not be extracted.

scope.description: CRITICAL NEW FIELD: Explicitly state what technology this requirement applies to. This prevents confusion. For requirements from geothermal-specific sections: 'Geothermal electricity only'. For requirements that genuinely apply to multiple technologies in the same section: 'Geothermal and solar' or 'All renewable energy facilities'. Most requirements should be 'Geothermal electricity only'.

target.description: FOR SETBACKS: What the distance is measured FROM (e.g., 'Residence', 'Property line', 'Rivers/streams'). FOR OTHER REQUIREMENTS: What the requirement applies TO (e.g., 'Geothermal production wells', 'All geothermal facilities'). Be specific about geothermal context.

value.description: Numeric value (e.g., 1320, 65, 100) or time range (e.g., '7 a.m. to 7 p.m.'). Extract numbers without units. Leave null for yes/no requirements.

unit.description: Unit of measurement exactly as written (e.g., 'feet', 'dBA', 'acres', 'USD'). Leave null if no unit.

details.description: Complete requirement text extracted verbatim from ordinance. Include all conditions, exceptions, qualifications. This is the authoritative legal language - do NOT paraphrase. CRITICAL: This text must come from a section about GEOTHERMAL, not solar/wind/other technologies.

section.description: Ordinance section reference exactly as cited (e.g., '6-3N-10-1C', 'Section 10-404(2)(c)'). This helps verify the requirement is from a geothermal section. Leave null only if no section numbering.
